question: Analyze the average percentage change in sales between the 12 weeks before and after June 15, 2020, for each attribute type: region, platform, age band, demographic, and customer type. For each attribute type, calculate the average percentage change in sales across all its attribute values. Identify the attribute type with the highest negative impact on sales and provide its average percentage change in sales.
sql:
-- Build the final result properly using CTEs
WITH weekly_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type,
        week_date,
        SUM(sales) as weekly_sales
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE week_date >= '2020-03-23' AND week_date <= '2020-09-07'
    GROUP BY region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type, week_date
),
-- Per attribute value: avg before and after sales
region_stats AS (
    SELECT region,
        AVG(CASE WHEN week_date < '2020-06-15' THEN weekly_sales END) as avg_before,
        AVG(CASE WHEN week_date > '2020-06-15' THEN weekly_sales END) as avg_after
    FROM weekly_agg GROUP BY region
),
region_pct AS (
    SELECT 'region' as attr_type,
        AVG(CASE WHEN avg_before > 0 THEN 1.0 * (avg_after - avg_before) / avg_before * 100 ELSE NULL END) as avg_pct_change
    FROM region_stats
),
platform_stats AS (
    SELECT platform,
        AVG(CASE WHEN week_date < '2020-06-15' THEN weekly_sales END) as avg_before,
        AVG(CASE WHEN week_date > '2020-06-15' THEN weekly_sales END) as avg_after
    FROM weekly_agg GROUP BY platform
),
platform_pct AS (
    SELECT 'platform' as attr_type,
        AVG(CASE WHEN avg_before > 0 THEN 1.0 * (avg_after - avg_before) / avg_before * 100 ELSE NULL END) as avg_pct_change
    FROM platform_stats
),
age_stats AS (
    SELECT age_band,
        AVG(CASE WHEN week_date < '2020-06-15' THEN weekly_sales END) as avg_before,
        AVG(CASE WHEN week_date > '2020-06-15' THEN weekly_sales END) as avg_after
    FROM weekly_agg GROUP BY age_band
),
age_pct AS (
    SELECT 'age_band' as attr_type,
        AVG(CASE WHEN avg_before > 0 THEN 1.0 * (avg_after - avg_before) / avg_before * 100 ELSE NULL END) as avg_pct_change
    FROM age_stats
),
demo_stats AS (
    SELECT demographic,
        AVG(CASE WHEN week_date < '2020-06-15' THEN weekly_sales END) as avg_before,
        AVG(CASE WHEN week_date > '2020-06-15' THEN weekly_sales END) as avg_after
    FROM weekly_agg GROUP BY demographic
),
demo_pct AS (
    SELECT 'demographic' as attr_type,
        AVG(CASE WHEN avg_before > 0 THEN 1.0 * (avg_after - avg_before) / avg_before * 100 ELSE NULL END) as avg_pct_change
    FROM demo_stats
),
ctype_stats AS (
    SELECT customer_type,
        AVG(CASE WHEN week_date < '2020-06-15' THEN weekly_sales END) as avg_before,
        AVG(CASE WHEN week_date > '2020-06-15' THEN weekly_sales END) as avg_after
    FROM weekly_agg GROUP BY customer_type
),
ctype_pct AS (
    SELECT 'customer_type' as attr_type,
        AVG(CASE WHEN avg_before > 0 THEN 1.0 * (avg_after - avg_before) / avg_before * 100 ELSE NULL END) as avg_pct_change
    FROM ctype_stats
)
SELECT attr_type, ROUND(avg_pct_change, 2) as avg_pct_change
FROM region_pct
UNION ALL SELECT * FROM platform_pct
UNION ALL SELECT * FROM age_pct
UNION ALL SELECT * FROM demo_pct
UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ctype_pct
ORDER BY avg_pct_change
